Summary

  • Core behaviour works on all three arms. Copy matches the wireframe, and the default math checks out: $1,799 total, $2,570, Saving $771, and V2 shows “ADD TO CART · SAVE $771”. Size changes, accessories and the Setup/Removal tier all re-price the line and the V2 button live. Add to Cart adds exactly one mattress, including through V2's cloned button. No cre-t-283 errors.
  • BUG-01 (Medium): V1/V2 have no guard when there's no compare price. They render a strike price lower than the total plus “Saving $0”, and V2 shows “ADD TO CART · SAVE $0”.
  • BUG-02 (Medium): the V1/V2 line and the V2 button force the Inter font, which the site never loads. They fall back to Helvetica Neue/Arial instead of the site font greycliff-cf that control uses. The wireframe only asks for +2px.
  • BUG-03 (Low): the V1/V2 preview links you were given open greenbuildingsupply.com, a different client. The working links are below.

Notes on the ⚠️ cells

  • TC-07 Chrome V1/V2, Safari V1: a WinkBeds timed popup (cre-wb-test-28-overlay, “We get it. You want to try your mattress…”) covered the button, so the forced click hit the overlay. A separate re-check with no popup showed V1 → cart 1, V2 → cart 1. Each made a single /cart/update.js {"updates":{"33210297618":1}}, so the V2 clone does not double-add.
  • TC-04 Chrome V1: the “before” read caught “Saving $0” because cre-t-202's “Was $2,570” badge hadn't populated yet. That's the stale-$0 race documented on WIN266, inherited by all arms. It corrected itself after the accessory click. TC-11 (15 fresh loads on Chrome) showed 0 mismatches.
  • Safari control TC-02/05/06 and V1 TC-05/06: in Playwright WebKit sessions the site's own price box stayed empty (“Was $ $”), so cre-t-202's strike badge had no value. Control then showed “Saving $0”, and V1 showed the BUG-01 symptom naturally. This is WebKit-on-Windows rendering, not confirmed on real Safari.
  • Safari V1 TC-08/09 and all V2: the run was stopped by the OS for low memory after a WebKit page hung, so V2 on Safari was not covered.

Bugs

MediumBUG-01: V1/V2 show a strike price lower than the total and “Saving $0” / “SAVE $0” when there's no compare price

Where: strikeTotal() in v2.js and va3.js. It sums .cre-t-202-box-strike-price (another test's “Was $X” badge), .order-form__loadup-button-compare-price and the accessories' sale prices, with no check that a compare price exists. The strike is always rendered, and V2 always appends “· SAVE $X” to the button.

Repro (Chrome, deterministic): open V1 or V2 → cre-t-202 badge removed/absent → tick Platform Frame. The line reads 2 items selected · $2,298 total $499 · Saving $0 and the V2 button reads ADD TO CART · SAVE $0.

Seen naturally (WebKit): 1 item selected · $1,799 total $0 · Saving $0 and, after adding Setup & Removal, 2 items selected · $2,024 total $300 · Saving $0.

Why it matters: the cre-t-202 price test can be paused, ended or slow to load. WIN283 then shows a nonsensical struck-through price and advertises “SAVE $0” on the main CTA. Control only degrades to “Saving $0”.

Suggested fix: render the .strike span only when strike > total. Drop “· Saving $X” and V2's “· SAVE $X” when saving is 0. Optionally, fall back to the native price box's compare-at price instead of the cre-t-202 badge.

MediumBUG-02: V1/V2 line and V2 button use a font that isn't loaded (Inter → falls back to Helvetica Neue/Arial)

v2.css and va3.css set font-family: "Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif !important on .cre-t-283-subtotal-line and .cre-t-283-add-btn. document.fonts has no Inter face on winkbeds.com, so it renders in a fallback system font. Control and every other Buy Box element use greycliff-cf.

ControlV1/V2 actualExpected (wireframe)

Line font-size13.2px15px+2px ≈ 15.2px (close enough)
V2 button fontgreycliff-cf 18px (native)Inter → Arial 16.7px, letter-spacing 2.8pxsame style as the native button, longer copy

Fix: remove the font-family overrides (inherit). If “ADD TO CART · SAVE $771” needs to fit on mobile, reduce letter-spacing only.

LowBUG-03: client-supplied V1/V2 preview links point to the wrong site

https://www.greenbuildingsupply.com/?cro_mode=qa&_conv_eforce=100052955.1000257634 (and …635) loads Green Building Supply's homepage (body class cre-t-13-manual-activation, no #orderForm, no cre-t-283). Use the corrected WinkBeds links above.

LowBUG-04: no real space between “total” and the struck-through price

The markup is $1,799 total<strong class="strike">$2,570</strong>: the gap is only padding-left:3px, and the strike is nested inside the bold “total” <strong>. Visually it's tighter than the wireframe's word space. Screen readers and copy-paste get “$1,799 total$2,570”. Fix: total</strong> <s class="strike">$2,570</s>.

Questions for the client

QuestionQ1: should accessory and cooling-fabric discounts count toward “Saving”?

In some loads (other live tests, e.g. cre-t-275) the accessories and Frost Cooling Fabric show compare prices, e.g. “Platform Frame $700 $499” and “$175 $125”. The cre-t-283 savings only include the mattress (cre-t-202 badge) and the Setup/Removal compare price. Adding Platform Frame raises the strike by +$499, and the saving stays $771 rather than $972. The code comment assumes “Accessories have no strike price”. Control (WIN266 logic) behaves the same, so this isn't a variation regression, but V1/V2 now show the strike explicitly.

NoteQ2: button item-count copy

Control and V1 change the native button to “ADD N ITEMS TO CART” when more than one item is selected; this is native site behaviour, as noted on WIN266. V2 replaces it with “ADD TO CART · SAVE $X” and drops the item count. That matches the wireframe; flagging it so the change is intentional.

What passed (Chrome)

  • Copy: control “1 item selected · $1,799 total · Saving $771”. V1/V2 add “$2,570”. V2 button: “ADD TO CART · SAVE $771”.
  • Strike style: rgba(255,255,255,.6), line-through, weight 400. Saving: #22C55E. Line: white, 600. Nothing overflows, and the line stays on one line even with WinkBase added.
  • King: $2,199 total $3,141 · Saving $942 / SAVE $942.
  • Setup & Removal ($300→$225): $2,024 total $2,870 · Saving $846 / SAVE $846 (+$75 correctly added).
  • Platform Frame: count 2, total $2,298, strike $3,069, saving unchanged; unticking reverts exactly.
  • After Add to Cart the line still shows the current selection, not the cart contents (per spec, like WIN266).
  • 15 fresh loads (5 per arm): 0 stale “Saving $0” or mismatches.

Coverage & caveats

  • Browsers: Playwright Chromium (Chrome Desktop) full; Playwright WebKit (Safari Desktop) control + V1 partial. V2 on Safari and real-device Safari (macOS/iOS) were not covered. Recommend a quick manual pass on a real Mac/iPhone, especially V2's button and BUG-01.
  • Mobile viewports weren't run this round (memory limits).
